Theme

Latin word

rūsticus

rūsticus, rūstica, rūsticum

declension

agricultural, of farming and the country; of the country, rural

In this lexicon

  • agricultural

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. de Or. 1.69: rēs rūstica (Lewis & Short); Cato Agr. 5.4: opus rūsticum omne

  • rural

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Rosc. Am. 75: vīta haec rūstica, quam tū agrestem vocās (Lewis & Short); Cic. Fam. 16.21.7: rūsticus Rōmānus factus es; Traupman 410

Examples

  • nam rēs rūstica sīc est, sī ūnam rem sērō fēceris, omnia opera sērō faciēs

    for farming is like this: if you do one thing late, you’ll do every job lateCato Agr. 5.7

    In the entry for agricultural

  • rūsticus Rōmānus factus es

    you’ve become a Roman countrymanCic. Fam. 16.21.7

    In the entry for agricultural

  • ōlim rūsticus urbānum mūrem mūs paupere fertur accēpisse cavō, veterem vetus hospes amīcum

    once upon a time, they say, a country mouse welcomed a town mouse in his poor hole, an old host his old friendHor. S. 2.6.79–81

    In the entry for rural
